Name: Amon, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Son of Manasseh king of Judah in the kingly line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:14: Son of Manasseh king of Judah in the kingly line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Amon stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
